body.p: , after , , , , , . src/xslt_lower_declaration.c, src/xslt_whitespace.c with src/xslt_whitespace_internal.h, tests/xslt_declaration_test.c; hooks in src/xslt_lower.c, src/xslt_lower_construct.c, src/xslt_lower_template.c, src/xslt_lower_control.c, src/processor.c. No IR kind, no evaluator change, no public header.

item.p: Stylesheet functions (10.3), as XQuery's declared functions (): sxml_xslt_declare_components (before templates) adds one IR function per arity of each component's arity range and puts a function table in front of every static context's (so patterns, AVTs, globals and 4.10's table see them); bodies are lowered after the templates (they may call them) with an absent focus, parameters as slots 1.., the result coerced to as (TRY_CATCH mapping XPTY0004 to XTTE0780). A shorter arity binds the defaults of the left-out optional parameters (required="no"; select, content as a temporary tree without as, else ()) and calls the full arity; a default "." is SXML_PARAMETER_DEFAULT_CONTEXT_VALUE (the caller's focus, supplied by the core); other defaults see no focus. Eclipsed functions (higher precedence, containing arity range) and those given up under override-extension-function="no" have no IR function. A function in no namespace switches the static contexts to NO_NAMESPACE_FIRST, the table falls back to fn, and unprefixed call names are interned first (as XQuery). XTSE0080, 0580, 0740, 0760, 0761, 0769, 0770, XTSE0020 (override vs override-extension-function). cache, new-each-time, streamability and visibility are ignored.

Attribute sets (10.2): all declarations of one name (by precedence, then order) are one IR function of the focus (item()?, position, size, as a template function) plus an absent-focus variant; each body is the invocations of every declaration's use-attribute-sets, then its xsl:attribute children. sxml_xslt_lowering_bind_attribute_sets calls them with the current focus; literal result elements, xsl:element and xsl:copy (with the selected item's focus) put the result before their own attributes. XTSE0710, XTSE0720 (explicit-stack DFS).

xsl:decimal-format: merged per name by import precedence (XTSE1290 only for a conflict at the winning precedence, XTSE1300 from sxml_decimal_format_apply) into the unit's static context (), which XSLT sets here, once; a packet adding collations to the unit's static context must merge with it.

xsl:global-context-item (3.4.9): checked in the main function before the invocation: XTDE3086 (required, none), XTTE0590 (as), XTSE3088 (a supplied item when use="absent"); XTSE3087, XTSE3089 statically. 4.8's bind_has_focus is now sxml_xslt_lowering_bind_has_focus. Item types of as (ITEM_TYPE values) are resolved as sequence types (their AST root is SEQUENCE_TYPE): this also fixes xsl:context-item's as (context-item 12 to 29 passed).

Whitespace stripping (4.2.2): a copy through a filtering tree builder (the specification's "copy of the source tree"), so parsed trees never change and nothing recurses; best match by precedence, default priority, declaration order; xml:space; XTSE0270. The host strips the global context item (sxml_xslt_strip_document); fn:doc and document() get stripped documents through a new document preparation of the processor's document loader (sxml_processor_document_loader_configuration.document_preparation, applied to documents from the resolver, not to available documents), which sxml_xslt_whitespace_stripping_as_document_preparation makes. 4.15 must install both.

Globals (extends ): initializers are lowered before the templates are released (a global's content may call a template: it crashed before); the computation order also follows the components an initializer reaches: a graph over declarations (globals read, functions named, templates called, every template rule for apply-templates, attribute sets used), whose strongly connected components (Tarjan, on an explicit stack) give the order. Cycles through components are left to the evaluator; 's direct cycles stay static errors.

Host parameters (): a supplied stylesheet parameter is a BOUND global slot of the unit, found by name (the evaluator coerces it, and its initializer does not run); static parameters also go to the reader. Nothing else was needed for the harness; 4.15 maps sxml_xslt_stylesheet_transform's parameters the same way.

Not done: xsl:character-map (4.13 owns serialization), memoization (cache, new-each-time="no": function-1025/1026/1031), a parameter left out before a keyword argument gets () not its default (the core's rule for library functions), function-lookup of stylesheet functions at run time (the dynamic context's table is the host's).

Measured with a scratch harness (lower, evaluate, serialize; XPath assertions; host parameters): function 13 to 98 of 124, attribute-set 1 to 47/49, strip-space 8 to 25/26, global-context-item 0 to 10/12, context-item 11 to 29/32, param 14 to 31/31, variable 16 to 90/108, whitespace 20 to 24/27 (before: HEAD of 4.8, without 4.7), format-number 66/70; 4.8's eleven sets 474 of 614 (: 316 of 615).
